Name: Maps: NEXT contact mask
Comment: Bit of the trigger source byte that means NEXT map (default 0x80). For src 0 / byte 0x7F9413: 0x80=sig0x15C  0x40=sig0x15E  0x20=sig0x15D  0x10=sig0x15A  0x04=sig0x161  0x02=sig0x158  0x01=sig0x160. For src 1 (0x7F9990 high byte) try 0x01 / 0x02 / 0x40 to test the rocker. NEVER set MASK_NEXT and MASK_PREV to the same bit: both edges then fire in one call (+1 then +2 = +3 mod 3 = no change).
Fieldvalues.Name: Maps: NEXT contact mask

Name: Maps: PREV contact mask
Comment: Bit of the trigger source byte that means PREVIOUS map (default 0x40). Swap the two masks to invert direction. One step per rising edge only. NEVER set MASK_NEXT and MASK_PREV to the same bit: both edges then fire in one call (+1 then +2 = +3 mod 3 = no change).
Fieldvalues.Name: Maps: PREV contact mask

Name: Maps: config
Comment: bit0=1: switch maps only while cruise is OFF (0x7F953A==0, the firmware's own test at 0x0ACCCC). bit1=1: disable stalk map switching completely. Default 0x01.
Fieldvalues.Name: Maps: config

Name: Maps: trigger source
Comment: Source byte for the masks. 0=0x7F9413 switch-contact byte (default). 1=0x7F9990 high byte -> rocker bits 8/9/14 appear as masks 0x01/0x02/0x40. 2=0x7F935D decoded rocker mode (1,2,3,5,7). Test 1 and 2 to find the ON/CANCEL/OFF contact, then hardwire and delete these rows.
Fieldvalues.Name: Maps: trigger source

Name: Maps: pedal gate
Comment: Pedal threshold for map switching, 16-bit raw compared directly. Scale is 0.01 %/bit so raw 0..10000 = 0..100.00 %. 0 = gate DISABLED (switch at any pedal). Non-zero blocks switching above that raw value, and a negative pedal is always blocked. Example 200 = 2.00 %.
Fieldvalues.Name: Maps: pedal gate

Name: Pedal: APP1 linearisation
Comment: APP1 linearisation | WHAT TO CHANGE: 2 points at $1C7926, axis $1C7922 (raw counts), data in % factor 0.01 | Maps raw sensor counts to 0.00-100.00 percent for pedal track 1. Axis is the raw count where that track reads 0 % and 100 %, data is the percent. Change an axis value to move a breakpoint, change the data to bend the curve. | CAUTION: GLOBAL - not cloned per slot. Affects all three slots, idle, and the APP1/APP2 plausibility comparison. Both tracks must stay consistent or the cross-check at 0x062B8C will fault.
Fieldvalues.Name: pedal percent (0..100.00)
AxisX.Name: raw pedal sensor count

Name: Pedal: APP2 linearisation
Comment: APP2 linearisation | WHAT TO CHANGE: 2 points at $1C79C6, axis $1C79C2 (raw counts), data in % factor 0.01 | Same as APP1 but for the second potentiometer track, which the hardware drives at roughly half the voltage. It is normal for the axis span to differ from APP1 - each track is normalised separately so nothing downstream sees the ratio. | CAUTION: GLOBAL - not cloned per slot. If this curve stops agreeing with APP1 the ECU sets a pedal plausibility fault (cross-check at 0x062B8C compares the two channels).
Fieldvalues.Name: pedal percent (0..100.00)
AxisX.Name: raw pedal sensor count

Name: Pedal: plausibility window
Comment: Pedal plausibility window | WHAT TO CHANGE: 4 points at $1C7958, axis $1C7950 (raw counts), data in % factor 0.01 | Stock shape is axis 0, 51, 438, 1023 with data 0, 0, 100, 100 percent: a dead zone below 51 counts, a ramp to full scale at 438, then held to the 1023-count ceiling. Change the axis to move the dead zone and the full-scale point, change the data to limit the usable range. | CAUTION: GLOBAL - not cloned per slot. This is a plausibility/characterisation curve, not the main pedal map - editing it can make the ECU reject the pedal signal entirely.
